example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষায় ভালো করতে সে অনেক গা ঘামিয়েছে।
এই কাজটা শেষ করতে গা ঘামাতে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He broke a sweat to do well in the exam.
You'll have to work up a sweat to finish this job.
note: This idiom reflects the physical aspect of labor in Bengali culture, emphasizing hard work through bodily exertion.
